translations.web: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
translations.bsb: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
translations.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring ➔ you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
translations.asv: For ye bear with a man, if he bringeth you into bondage, if he devoureth you, if he taketh you captive, if he exalteth himself, if he smiteth you on the face.
